build_bert_bpe_encoder: build a BertBPE encoder using bert-base-uncased tokenizer to encode text into BPE tokens
encode_text_with_bert_bpe: encode a string into space-separated BPE tokens using the BertBPE encode method
decode_bert_bpe_tokens: decode space-separated BPE tokens back into readable text using the BertBPE decode method
check_beginning_of_word: check if a BPE token is the beginning of a word using the is_beginning_of_word method
create_bert_bpe_config: create a BertBPEConfig dataclass with cased setting and custom vocab file path
